values.note: Mason County rates (one rate, no resident/non-resident split): electric & water $30/night, full hook-up $35, per family unit of 2 adults and children under 16; additional adults $5/night (4-adult maximum); $1/night off for 7+ consecutive nights. Camper cabins $55, deluxe $65. $5 non-refundable reservation fee per site.

values.note: Reserved with the county's reservation form (mail or email to mccampground@masoncounty.net) or by phone at the campground; one night's fee plus the $5 reservation fee as deposit, full payment due by Feb 1 for the following season. Cancel 30+ days ahead for a 50% refund.

Full payment is due by Feb 1'), read 2026-10-22

note: Mason County (county government) campground, 5906 W Chauvez Rd, Ludington, under tall hardwoods; a nature path leads to the picnic area and disc golf course, and Lake Michigan is under 5 minutes away. Inland/wooded, no water body. Open roughly Memorial Day-Labor Day. Distinct facility from the Mason County Fairgrounds campground ~4 mi away. --Claude
